## Related issue

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] Changes to scanning, references, normalisation, filters, trash, restore or delete include a test proving referenced files are kept
- [ ] `composer test` passes (Pint + Pest)
- [ ] README updated if behaviour, options or commands changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] No breaking change, **or** the breaking change is clearly described above
